description: Delete an object zone: DELETE /api/v1/zones/:zone_id answers 202 with the zone in state deleting. A zone with objects needs recursive=true (else 409 zone.not_empty), a zone with a held object answers 409 zone.held, and the default zone answers 409 zone.default. Media tombstones every object at once, with no restore window, and erases every copy within 24 hours. A hold placed after the request delays only that object's purge. The name is retired, never reused. Callers: a developer app of the project with this capability, or a person who administers the project, signed in on openvibe.zone.
